source_evidence: Retirement share classes are typically only available through an employer-sponsored retirement plan, such as a 401(k).
question: Misconception: Retirement share classes are available to any investor who wants to buy them.
answer: Correction: Retirement share classes are typically available through employer-sponsored retirement plans, such as a 401(k). A fund may offer more than one retirement share class, and their ongoing expenses can differ, including whether they have 12b-1 fees.
